author: Hoon Kim
title: Looking for a 2D Character Illustrator
content:
Looking for a 2D Character Illustrator
We'll provide character design concepts. You'll create high-quality, commercial-use illustrations with poses and backgrounds.
Quality level matching the attached characters
Requirements:
- Japanese anime art style (see attached images)
- Experience with 2D game character art
- Faithful to the original design (hair, outfit, colors)
To apply: Send your portfolio.
Feel free to reach out!

author: Kisai Entertainment
title: Your Career with Kisai - Week 2 November - Hiring Artists
content:
Your Career with Kisai - Week 2 November
Hai, Kisai Enthusiast!
Weekly update lowongan Kisai sudah tayang lagi nih!
Kalau kamu siap berkembang, berkarya, dan jadi bagian dari proyek webtoon seru bersama tim Kisai, ini bisa jadi momennya kamu!
Kisai sedang mencari:
1. Line Artist
2. Base & Shading Artist
3. Finishing Artist
4. Storyboard Artist
5. Business Development Officer (KY Academy)
6. Business Development Officer (Original IP)
Cek semua posisi yang tersedia dan apply di: kisaient.com/careers
Masih ada yang mau ditanyakan? Langsung DM saja ya!
Lamaran hanya diterima melalui website resmi Kisai Entertainment.
